source: Plan v2 Phase 5: the 7 forms merged from the TDD's 22, each wired to its sections (seed/sections.json).

data.name: Profile & Experience
data.purpose: Education, roles, years of experience, industries, markets and international exposure; CV/LinkedIn links. Context for the report — capped self-report contribution (TDD F01–F02).

data.name: Career Motivation
data.purpose: Why consulting, target practice areas and industries, start readiness and development preferences (TDD F03, F21–F22).

data.name: Talent DNA
data.purpose: Ranked-response items across purpose, curiosity, systems thinking, innovation, communication, leadership, teamwork, consulting DNA and future thinking — scored 4-3-2-1 (TDD F04, §9.1).

data.name: Values (Schwartz-informed)
data.purpose: Theory-aligned items across the 10 basic values and 4 higher-order views; centred on the candidate's own mean (MRAT). Descriptive only — never pass/fail (TDD F05, §9.2–9.4).

data.name: Consulting Capability
data.purpose: One ~20-question module merging strategy, research, value chain, process/TOM, transformation, programme and AI awareness (TDD F06–F14).

data.name: Written Communication
data.purpose: One memo-style executive response, AI-scored against a published rubric (TDD F15).

data.name: Case Study
data.purpose: One ambiguous enterprise case: issue tree, hypotheses, options, recommendation and risks — written or uploaded response, AI-scored against a rubric (TDD F17–F18).
